title: 910 Race 2026 Review: What the First 910Nineten Race Was Like
meta_description: 910Nineten Race review: the first edition drew 2,000-2,500 runners to ICE BSD on 9 November 2025, on a wide, flat route with two flyovers. What to expect in 2026.
dek: Indonesian shoe brand 910 Nineten staged its own race for the first time at ICE BSD in November 2025. Here is what that first edition was like, ahead of the second.
verdict: The 910Nineten Race is a local brand's own race, and its first edition went well by the accounts published. It was held on Sunday 9 November 2025 at ICE BSD in Tangerang, with the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon [1][2]. Reports put the field at about 2,000 [1] to 2,500 runners [2], from beginners to national athletes [1]. The route ran through BSD City's green areas on wide, flat, well-kept roads, with two flyovers for a challenge [1]. If you want a half marathon near Jakarta on a flat, tidy course, it is worth a look.

sections.heading: The First Edition
paragraphs: The race was held on Sunday 9 November 2025 at the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Tangerang [1][2]. Reports give the field as about 2,000 [1] or 2,500 [2], from beginners to national athletes [1].
It was the first time the Indonesian running-shoe brand 910 Nineten had organised its own race [1][2], and the brand used it to launch a new racing shoe [1].

sections.heading: The Route
paragraphs: The route passed through the green areas of BSD City [1]. Runners had wide, flat, well-kept roads, with two flyovers adding some challenge [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon near Jakarta on a flat, well-surfaced course, yes. The first edition was a manageable size.
It is a young event from a brand, so expect the race to be used to promote the brand's shoes. That does not affect the running, but it shapes the atmosphere.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the first edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the first 910Nineten Race?
faqs.answer: Between about 2,000 and 2,500, depending on the report, on Sunday 9 November 2025 at ICE BSD, Tangerang. The field ranged from beginners to national athletes across the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon.

faqs.question: What is the 910Nineten Race route like?
faqs.answer: Flat and wide. In 2025 the route ran through the green areas of BSD City on wide, well-kept roads, with two flyovers adding a little climbing. It suits runners who want steady pacing.

faqs.question: Who organises the 910 Race?
faqs.answer: 910 Nineten, an Indonesian running-shoe brand. The 2025 race was the first time the brand had staged its own event, and it used it to launch a new racing shoe.
